title: An AI import draft keeps the folder a site is installed in
steps: Parse a draft whose importUrl is https://example.test/shop/ (and /shop, /shop/index.php) on the server, and as tab metadata in Add site.
expect: The draft is accepted with importUrl https://example.test/shop/; an admin page, credentials, a query or a fragment are still refused.

tests: import addresses carry no credentials or operations
malformed metadata and unsafe import URLs cannot prefill a form
